Honourable Speaker, briefing paper on the operation and implementation of The New Wildlife Law, The Wildlife Conservation Act, 2009. The Wildlife Conservation Act (the Act) is a law which was enacted in 2009 to make better provisions for the conservation management, protection and sustainable utilization of wildlife and wildlife products and to provide for other related matters. This law came into effect on the 13th day of March 2009.

Honourable Speaker, first, is about shortcoming and impracticability of Section 21 of the Act on grazing rights. Section 21 of the Act restricts any person to graze any livestock in any game controlled area save with written permission of the Director of Wildlife previously sought and obtained. The section further provides that non compliance of the above requirement is an offence and the person shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding five hundred thousand or imprisonment for a term not exceeding five years.
Section 21(1) Any person shall not, save with the written permission of the Director previously sought and obtained, graze any livestock in any game controlled area.

(2) Any person who contravenes this section commits an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine of not less than one hundred thousand shillings but not exceeding five hundred thousand shillings or imprisonment for a term of not less than one year but not exceeding five years, or both.

Honourable Speaker, before the coming into effect of this Act and declaring certain areas game controlled areas, there were certain communities living within these areas conducting their daily economic activities (livestock keeping). It is therefore impractical, cumbersome and

unrealistic to require a local villager of a certain village located within a game controlled area to seek for a written permission from the Director of Wildlife to be allowed to graze his cattle within a game controlled area.

This requirement might result in chaos and conflict between the indigenous communities living within the game controlled areas and the Government. This is a general land use planning matter which the government seemingly overlooked when drafting the Act. The preparation of Land Use Management Plans over these areas is of paramount importance as a means to clearly identify, demarcate and pinpoint the economic activities to be carried thereon.

Honourable Speaker, second, limitations of Section 38 of the Act on Transparency and Good Governance in allocation of Hunting Blocks. Under the above Act, hunting blocks are allocated to applicants by the Minister after consultation by the Hunting Block Allocation Advisory Committee under section 38(6) of the Act. Under section 38(3) of the Act, the Hunting Block Advisory Committee consists of members appointed by the Minister including the Director General of Tanzania Wildlife Research Institute, the Director General of Tanzania National Parks; a representative of the Attorney General, the principal of College of Wildlife Management; any other five persons appointed by the Minister; and the Director of Wildlife who shall be the Secretary.

Further section 38(4) requires the Minister when appointing the five persons as stated above, shall have regards to the needs of gender balance, knowledge and experience in business administration, environmental conservation matters relating to economic empowerment. The Act also imposes an obligation on the Minister to ensure that any modality or system used in allocation of hunting blocks is transparent and is inline with the principles of good governance as provided under section 38(11) of the Act.
Transparency under the Oxford English Dictionary generally means openness, communication and accountability.

Good governance is an indeterminate term used in development literature to describe how public institutions conduct public affairs and manage public resources in order to guarantee the realization of human rights. Good governance is a form of governance that embodies eight specific characteristics, and can be seen as an ideal of governance. Good governance embodies processes that are participatory, consensus oriented, accountable, transparent, responsive, effective and efficient, equitable and inclusive, and which follow the rule of law.”

The Minister under the Act has been given vast powers in the entire process of allocation of hunting blocks. The current appointmtent of the five persons sitting under the Hunting Block Advisory Committee is not transparent and does not encompass the ethos of good governmance. This is due to the fact that the criteria of appointment stated under the Act which needs to be taken into account by the Minister, were not put to the public for scrutiny as a means to justify such appointments.
Section 38(3) The Hunting Block Allocation Advisory Committee shall consist of following members to be appointed by the Minister:-
(a) The Director General of Tanzania Wildlife Research Institute;
(b) The Directsor General of Tanzania National Parks;
(c) A representative of the Attorney General;
(d) The principal of College of Wildlife Management;
(e) Any other five persons appointed by the Minister; and
(f) The Director of Wildlife who shall be the Secretary.
(4) In appointing persons referred to in paragraph (e) of subsection, (3), the Minister shall
have regards to the need for gender balance, knowledge and experience in business
administration, environmental conservation matters relating to economic
empowerment.
Section 38(6) The Minister shall, upon advice by the Committee, allocate a hunting block to the applicant.
Section 38(11) The Minister shall ensure that any modality or system used in allocation of hunting blocks is transparent and is inline with the principles of good governace.
Honourable Speaker, third is about conflict of section 39(3)(a) of the Act with Section 22(b) of the Tanzania Investment Act, 1997.

Section 39(3)(a) of the Act provides that a minimum of 25% of the shares in a foreign hunting company shall be owned by Tanzanians in order for the company to be eligible for allocation of hunting blocks. The requirement has thus forced the existing foreign hunting companies which have secured their investment under the Tanzania Investment Centre, to sell 25% of their shares to nationals so as to meet the requirement of the Law. This requirement of the law conflicts with section 22 of the Tanzania Investment Act,1997 which guarantees all investors who own, whether wholly or in part, the capital of any business enterprise not to be compelled by any law to cede his/its interest in the capital to any other person.

Section 39(3) of the Act the Minister may make regulations prescribing for shares to be owned by citizens in any hunting company, the number of hunting blocks to be owned by a company, criteria, size and value of hunting blocks but in any case.
(a) The shares to be owned by the citizens shall not be less than twenty five percent of subscribed shares;
Section 22(b) of the Tanzania Investment Act Subject to subsection (2) and (3) of this section.
(a) No person who owns, whether wholly or in part, the capital of any business enterprise shall be compelled by law to cede his interest in the capital to any other person.

This provision of the Act therefore conflicts with the Tanzania Investment Act as it contravenes the investment guarantee given to foreign investors by forcing them to cede part of their capital to other persons.

The anomaly can create disputes between the Government of the United Republic of Tanzania, the Tanzania Investment Centre and foreign investors. Section 23(2) or the Tanzania Investment Act gives three options to foreign investors to pursue should a dispute arise between them, the Tanzania Investment Centre and the Government of the United Republic of Tanzania where amicable settlement has failed.

The foreign investors may submit their disputes to arbitration forums in accordance with arbitration laws of Tanzania for investors; or in accordance with the rules of procedure for arbitration of the International Centre for the Settlement of Investment Disputes; or within the framework of any bilateral or multilateral agreement on investment protection agreed to by the Government of the United Republic and the Government of the Country the Investor originates.

Section 23(2) of the Tanzania Investment Act reads: „A dispute between a foreign investor and the Centre or the Government in respect of a business enterprise which is not settled through negotiations may be submitted to arbitration in accordance with any of the following methods as may be mutually agreed by the parties, that is to say:-
(a) in accordance with arbitration laws of Tanzania for investors;
(b) in accordance with the rules of procedure for arbitration of the International Centre for the Settlement of Investment Disputes;

(c) Within the framework of any bilateral or multilateral agreement on investment protection agreed to by the Government of the United Republic and the Government of the Country the Investor originates”.

Section 39(3) of the Act empowers the Minister to make regulation prescribing for shares to be owned by citizens in any hunting company among others. To rescue the above anomaly, the Minister needs to make regulations prescribing ownership of shares in hunting companies to be 50% citizens and 50% foreign investors. The doctrines of Internationsl business are rooted in the philosophy of risk sharing. Risk sharing promotes more investment as the burden of capital is not solely borne by one person. In turn this shall encourage many Tanzanian citizens to invest in the hunting sector.
Section 39(3) of the Act The Minister may make regulations prescribing for shares to be owned by citizens in any hunting company…
Honourable Speaker, four is about Section 39(3)(b) of the Act is unconstitutional as it contravenes Article 13 of the Constitution of the United Republic of Tanzania on equality before the law.

Section 39(3)(b) of the Act provides that, the percentage of foreign owned companies allocated hunting blocks shall not exceed fifteen percent of the total hunting companies at any particular time. This provision of the Act is unconstitutional as it discriminates against those Tanzanian citizens who own 25% of shares in the foreign hunting companies as allocation of hunting blocks to such companies is restricted by the Act to only 15% of the total hunting companies. This implies that a Tanzania citizen owning shares in a foreign company is treated differently from Tanzania citizen owning shares in a local company which contravenes Article 13 of the Constitution of the United Republic of Tanzania.

Article 13 of the Constitution of United Republic of Tanzania advocates that all persons are equal before the law and are entitled without any discrimination, to protection and equality before the law. The Article also is to the effect that, no Law enacted by any authority in the United Republic of Tanzania shall make any provision that is discriminatory either of itself or in its effect. For the purpose of this Article the expression discrimination means to satisfy the needs, rights or other requirements of different persons on the basis of nationality, tribe, place of origin…
Article 13(1) All persons are equal before the law and are entitled, without any discrimination, to protection and equality before the law.
(2) No law enacted by any authourity in the United Republic shall make any provision that is discriminatory either of itself or in its effect.

(3) For the purposes of this Article the expression „Discriminate” means to satisfy the needs, rights or other requirements of different persons on the basis of their nationality, tribe, place of origin, political opinion, colour, religion, sex or station in life such that certain categories of people are regarded as weak or…

Currently there are 30 foreign hunting companies which have been operating in the hunting business for the past 25 years and have applied for allocation of hunting blocks for the period from 2013 to 2018. Only nine foreign companies which represent 15% of the total foreign companies will be allocated hunting blocks as required by the Law and leaving out 21 companies to close down their operations.

The implication of the above mentioned closures will result in the government of Tanzania losing direct taxes of up to Tshs. 50 billion from these companies. Records have proven that these foreign companies have been complying with the obligation to pay the required taxes as well as Wildlife Division Fees.

It is well known that these foreign hunting companies have heavily invested in research and monitoring of the hunting blocks. They possess enormous knowledge, skill, information and data of all the animal species and related features within wildlife econsystems in Tanzania. This is the key element in the hunting business and Tanzanians are still building the capacity, skill and knowledge to conduct such research as we still rely on foreign donors to fund and conduct such research.

Furthermore, up to 5,200 employees will lose their jobs due to the foreign companies closing down their operations in Tanzania. This will also occasion loss in taxes paid to the Government such as SDL, PAYE et cetera.

It has been observed that certain laws encourages foreign Investors to invest in our country and grants Investment guarantees to them and at the same time the government enacts laws which discourages foreign Investments and contravenes on the investment guarantees.

The Minister responsible should address the apparent fundamental predicaments caused by the above mentioned provisions of the Wildlife Conservation Act and start process to amend the said provision to comply with the Constitution of the United Republic of Tanzania and the Tanzania Investment Act so as to boost and stimulate economic growth through the hunting business and to honour its Investment guarantees to foreign Investors.

The laws making process is dynamic that means any law can be changed at any point in time. Most of the problems with enacted laws are usually noticed and observed during the implementation of the laws. The responsible Ministers have been given powers to rectify such abnormalities found in the laws.

For example the Land Act, No.4 of 1999 under section 20(3) provided that, all land acquired prior to the enactment of the Land Act shall be deemed to have no value. This meant that all the land in Tanzania had no value and therefore could not be mortgaged in Banks for certain values.

This section was later discovered not to be economically sound and in 2004 through the Land (Amendment) Act under section 4 which is to the effect that all the land in Tanzania has value save for the land acquired by non citizens prior to the enactment of the Land Act except for unexhaused improvements.
Section 20(3) of the Land Act stipulates that, all lands acquired prior to the enactment of this Act shall be deemed to have no value save for unexhaused improvements.

Section 4 of the Land (Amendment) Act stipulates that for the purpose of compensation made pursuant to this Act or any other written law, all lands acquired by non-citizens prior to the enactment of this act shall be deemed to have no value except for unexhausted improvements…
Waheshimiwa Wabunge, tukirudi mchana, Waziri mhusika ataanza kujibu hoja zenu. Kwa hiyo, wale ambao hawakupata nafasi ni bahati mbaya, waliitwa walikuwa hawapo.
Mheshimiwa Kigwangalla, mbona unasimama nikiwa mimi nimesimama! Kulikuwa na nini? Enhee, nakuita Dokta Kigwangalla.
MWONGOZO WA SPIKA

Mheshimiwa Spika, ahsante. Mimi siku ya Alhamisi wiki iliyopita wakati wa kipindi cha Maswali na Majibu, nilipata fursa ya kuuliza swali la nyongeza kuhusiana na posho za madaktari. Swali hili lilijibiwa na Mheshimiwa Dokta Lucy Nkya, Naibu Waziri wa Wizara hiyo.

Mheshimiwa Spika, na nilimuomba mimi afute kauli yake kwamba Madaktari hawapewi posho ya nyumba na kwamba imefutwa kinyume cha Sheria. Yeye alisema kwamba wanapewa! Lakini mimi leo hii nilisema kwamba kauli hiyo haikuwa ya ukweli.

Mheshimiwa Spika, sasa ninaomba Mwongozo wako kama ili kuweka kumbukumbu sahihi, Mheshimiwa Waziri atakubali sasa kufuta kauli yake, kurekebisha na hatimaye kuwachukulia hatua Wakuu wa Vitengo, Idara na sehemu mbalimbali za Serikali ambapo Madaktari wameajiriwa na hawalipwi posho za nyumba, lakini vilevile hawapewi nyumba, kinyume cha Standing Order ya Serikali ya mwaka 1994 na pia Standing Order ya Serikali ya mwaka 2009 na pia Sera ya Utumishi wa Umma. Naomba Mwongozo wako.

Waheshimiwa Wabunge, mara nyingi mkikuta kama kuna tatizo la namna hii mnafika pale ofisini, tuna ofisi yetu nzima kabisa ya ushauri wa namna ya kuendesha mambo kama haya. Kwa hiyo, kwa maana ya suala hilo wewe ungekuwa umefanya hilo, sisi tungekupa kwenye adjoinment motion, unasimama kwamba juzi Waziri alisema hivi na hivi na mimi nimefanya utafiti wangu hivi na hivi; inakuwa imekuwa kwa utaratibu. Maana sasa ukimwambia ajibu huyu, hawezi kujibu kwa sababu, hakujua.

Kwa hiyo, nakuomba ufanye utaratibu wa namna hiyo. Tunao utaratibu kabisa wa Kanuni. Kama ulijibiwa hapa kitu chochote ambacho wewe ulikuja kuamini baadaye sio sahihi alivyosema, una uhuru wa uwezo kabisa wa kutumia Kanuni zetu kui-refeer back. Lakini kile Kitengo chetu cha Ushauri wa Kisheria, mkitumie vizuri. Kwa hiyo, unafika hapa haupotezi muda unapata muda kabisa, unajieleza na wenyewe wanaohusika itabidi wajibu kadiri inavyostahili. Nilikuona Mheshimiwa Susan Kiwanga.
Mheshimiwa Spika, ahsante. Naomba kutumia Kanuni ya 48, inayohusu Jambo la Dharura na Kifungu cha 3(a), (b) na (c) kwa ruhusa yako.
Na wewe unataka nini sasa? Mwongozo wa kwangu? Hakuna ku-discuss chochote; kuhusu nini? Eleza kitu unachotaka kuongozwa.
Mheshimiwa Spika, kuna jambo la dharura. Kutatokea tatizo kubwa sana hali ya sukari nchini itazidi kuwa mbaya kiasi kwamba licha ya agizo la Rais, kwamba…

Mheshimiwa Mbunge, suala la sukari haliwezi kuwa la dharura. Dharura aliyozungumza asubuhi, ni kama alivyosema Mheshimiwa Wenje, sasa umeme hauwaki. Sasa naomba utafute utaratibu mzuri zaidi wa kuliendesha suala lako hilo. Naomba utafute utaratibu mzuri wa Kikanuni na kama umeshindwa tafuta ushauri kwa Idara yetu ya Sheria, utapata maelezo zaidi.

Waheshimiwa Wabunge, mambo ya kidharura ni dharura kweli kweli! Kwa mfano lile swali alilouliza Mheshimiwa Wenje, inawezekana watu hospitali wanakufa! Wapo kwenye operation wanakufa! Ndio maana tukamwambia, alivyoeleza ni dakika tano, tumeshaagiza hapa tutapata majibu saa 10.00 jioni ikiwezekana. Sasa mengine tusifanye kila kitu ni dharura, hatutaweza kwenda kufanya kazi yetu. Sasa hilo la kwako, tafuta utaratibu wa Kikanuni, utashauriwa, halafu tutapata namna ya kuliingiza hapa.

Waheshimiwa Wabunge, saa ya kusitisha shughuli za Bunge imefika, wale niliokuwa nawaita walikuwa hawapo, siwezi kuwaita tena, muda wenyewe umeshapita. Kwa hiyo, mchana tukirudi Waziri anayehusika ataanza kujibu hoja za Wabunge.
Nasitisha shughuli za Bunge, mpaka saa 10.:00.

div.note: (Saa 7.10 mchana Bunge lilifungwa mpaka saa 10.00 jioni)

u.seg: Hoja za Serikali
Waheshimiwa Wabunge nilikuwa nimeeleza kwamba tutakaporudi kipindi hiki cha jioni tutamruhusu Mheshimiwa Waziri aanze kujibu hoja zetu. Mheshimiwa mtoa hoja.

Mheshimiwa Spika, awali ya yote naomba nianze kwa kumshukuru sana Mwenyezi Mungu mwingi wa rehema kwa kunijalia uzima na baraka nyingi. Mungu roho Mtakatifu kwa maombezi ya Bikira wa Maria Mama wa Huruma, amekuwa akiniongoza mara zote katika kufanya kazi hii ambayo ni ngumu sana. Namuomba azidi kunijalia hekima na busara katika kukabiliana na majukumu yangu mengi na mazito kwa Taifa letu.

Mheshimiwa Spika, naomba pia niwashukuru sana viongozi wangu wa kiroho, hasa Askofu wangu Ludovick Joseph Minde na Mashehe, Mapadri, wachungaji na watawa wote wa Kahama ambao siku zote wamekuwa nami katika sala. Nawashukuru sana kwa sala zao na ushauri wao wa mara kwa mara nikutanapo nao. Ninawaomba sana waendelee kuniombea, kwani kama ambavyo wengi wao wanaona na kusikia kwenye vyombo vya habari kazi yangu ni ngumu, ni nzito ni changamoto ni kubwa.

Mheshimiwa Spika, kipekee kabisa naomba niwashukuru wananchi wenzangu wa Jimbo la Msalala kwa kuniamini kwa mara nyingine na kunichagua kuwa Mbunge wao. Kama ambavyo nimekuwa nikiwahakikisha mara kwa mara kwamba nitafanya kila niwezalo kuhakikisha kuwa maajabu ya maendeleo tunayotarajia ambayo yameanza kuonekana yanakuwa ni timilifu kweli. Najua kama ambavyo wao wenyewe wanajua kwamba harakati za kuleta mapinduzi ya maendeleo kwenye jimbo letu zimeanza. Kuna miradi kadhaa ambayo hata wao wanaishuhudia sasa hivi, mradi wa kupeleka umeme Mpera unaendelea kutekelezwa, ujenzi wa mabweni pale Isaka unaendelea, matengenezo ya barabara ya Nyambura hadi Ngogwa, Mega, Nyaminji hadi Nyamuguta, Luguya hadi Nyamishega. Pia mkandarasi yupo site akichimba visima kwenye vijiji vya Bushinga na Kakola ambavyo vimekuwa na tatizo sugu la maji kwa muda mrefu.

Mheshimiwa Spika, kama kawaida yetu na kama nilivyokuwa nikiwaambia sitawapotezea muda, muda wao wa kujitafutia maisha kwa kuwaingiza kwenye harakati ambazo hawapaswi kuzifanya. Kwani kuwaingiza kwenye harakati kama maandamano, ni kuonyesha ishara kwamba mimi mwakilishi wao nimeshindwa kuwasemea na hivyo ninawataka wao wajisemee wenyewe kana kwamba hawana mwakilishi. Nitafanya kazi hiyo kwa moyo wangu wote na muda wote nawaomba waendelee kufanya shughuli zao zingine na mimi nitawajibika kuwasemea kama ambavyo nimekuwa nikiwaahidi wakati wa kuomba kura zao.

Mheshimiwa Spika, natambua na wananchi wangu wanajua kwamba eneo letu lina matatizo mengi, lakini niwahakikishie kwamba taarifa zote za matatizo ya eneo letu zimekuwa zikifika Serikali na najua wao wanajua kwamba tuna tatizo kubwa sana la uhaba wa chakula sasa hivi. Lakini katika hili kama ambavyo tumekuwa tukikabili matatizo mengine tutashirikiana nao mimi mwenyewe na wao pia pamoja na Serikali yetu kuhakikisha kwamba tunakabiliana nalo.

Mheshimiwa Spika, mwisho naomba kipekee niwashukuru sana wana familia wangu, nikianza na mke wangu mpenzi Riberata, watoto wetu pamoja na wazazi wetu wote wa pande mbili ambao wamekuwa wakinishauri, kuniasa na kuniombea. Nawaomba waendelee kuniombea na kunitia moyo katika kufanya kazi ngumu na nzito na muhimu kwa Taifa letu.
Mheshimiwa Spika, baada ya shukrani hizo naomba nizungumze hoja mbalimbali ambazo Waheshimiwa Wabunge wamechangia. Lakini kabla ya kuzungumzia hoja zao naomba nianze
kwa kuwashukuru sana Waheshimiwa Wabunge, kwanza kwa imani kubwa ambayo wanayo kwangu binafsi. Lakini pia kwa kutambua changamoto ambazo Wizara yetu inazo.

Wizara yetu kama mnavyojua inagusa maisha ya watu ya kila siku, Wizara yetu inawagusa watu kiuchumi, inawagusa kimaisha, hasa pale ambapo maisha yao ya kila siku kama kilimo na hata mifugo yanakuwa yanaingiliana na shughuli zetu za uhifadhi.

Mheshimiwa Spika, changamoto hizi ndiyo hizo naziombea fedha leo hii ili tuweze kuzikabili, naamini kwamba pamoja na matatizo mengi yaliyojitokeza kule tulikotoka, tukishirikiana na Watanzania wenzangu na wananchi wenzangu naamini kwamba tutaweza kutatua changamoto hizi. John Komba, Mheshimiwa Brigedia Jenerali Hassan Ngwilizi na Mheshimiwa Dkt. David Mallole.

Naomba pia Waheshimiwa kama kuna mwingine nitakuwa nimesahau naomba mniletee ki-note nitawatambua. Mheshimiwa Zarina Shamte Madabida, na Waheshimiwa wote ambao nitakuwa kidogo nime-pronounce vibaya majina yenu, naomba radhi sana hasa wale ambao ni wa Ukanda wa Pwani kwa sababu kwetu kule „r” wa inatupa kazi sana.
Tunaanza kuhesabu saa moja kuanzia sasa.

Mheshimiwa Spika, nashukuru sana kama ambavyo nimesema awali michango ambayo imetolewa na Waheshimiwa Wabunge ni mingi sana. Wamezungumzia maeneo mengi mbalimbali nitajitahidi kupitia hoja zao kwa haraka iwezekanavyo lakini pia kwa kina kadri nitakavyoweza.

Mheshimiwa Spika, la kwanza nizungumzie suala la utoroshaji wa wanyamapori, labda kwanza nieleze kwa kifupi mwanzo wa tatizo au mwanzo wa suala lenyewe. Kwanza biashara hii ya ukamataji wa wanyama, ni halali kwa maana ya kwamba ipo kwenye Sheria ya Wanyamapori, Sheria Na. 5 ya mwaka 2009, Kifungu cha 50. Kifungu kile kinasema kwamba mtu yeyote anaruhusiwa kuomba leseni na kwenye kanuni tumesema biashara hii ni kwa Watanzania. Kwa sababu matarajio ni kwamba biashara hiyo itakuwa ni kwa kiwango kidogo, small scale business ambayo ni kwa Watanzania kwa ajili ya kujikimu. Ukihitaji kufanya biashara hiyo unaomba Trophy Dealers Licenses kwa hiyo unakuwa lincesed kufanya kazi hiyo.

Mheshimiwa Spika, mpaka sasa kuna kampuni 180 ambazo zina leseni ya kufanya kazi hiyo, leseni inatolewa si mara moja unakuwanayo lakini unakuwa unaomba vibali vya kukamata. Ukishakuwa na leseni kitu cha pili kinachohitajika ni kibali cha kukamata. Lakini kabla ya kupewa kibali unatakiwa uwe umeshajiandaa kibiashara kwa kuwa na eneo la biashara pamoja na eneo la kuwaweka wale wanyama. Utaratibu unadai kwamba wanyama ukishakamata wawekwe kwenye zizi, tunaita holding ground ambayo inatambulika na Idara ya Wanyamapori ambapo utawaweka wanyama hao wakati unafanya logistics za usafirishaji. Ukishawakamata kwa kutumia capture permit ambayo unakuwa umepewa, hatua ya tatu inayofuata ukishakuwa umewaleta mpaka kwenye zizi au kwanza utaratibu wenyewe wa ukamataji. Ukishaomba kukamata ukapewa capture permit, unatakiwa kutaja unaenda kukamata kwenye eneo gani na kwenye maelekezo unatakiwa kwenda kuripoti kwa district game officer ambaye utaambatana naye pamoja na

wakamataji ambao wanapewa vibali vya kukamata vinaitwa trepans card. Ukishakamata unawaleta kwenye zizi, ukiwafikisha pale kwenye zizi unawaombea kibali kingine kinaitwa ownership certificate, kwa hiyo, wanakuwa pale kwenye zizi lako, huku ukiwa unawamiliki kihalali na maafisa wetu wa wanyamapori wanakagua mazizi hayo, mara kwa mara. Utawaweka pale kwenye zizi kwa muda fulani kutegemea na logistics za usafirishaji.

Mheshimiwa Spika, hatua ya mwisho inayofuata ni pale ambapo unakuwa ume-confirm order na umemaliza mambo ya logistics za ndege unaomba kibali cha kusafirisha nje. Wamewekwa kwenye makundi mawili, kuna wanyama ambao wapo kwenye hatari ya kutoweka ambao wapo kwenye mkataba wa cites na kuna wanyama ambao hawapo kwenye hatari ya kutoweka wao hawapo kwenye hiyo list, kwa hiyo, utakachopewa au kibali utakachoomba ni cites permit ambayo ni document ya kutumia kusafirisha wanyama na ukishaitoa kule wanakopelekwa wale wanyama na kwenye wanaipokea na wanatunza kumbukumbu. Kama yule hayupo cites list, unapewa export certificate unasafirisha.

Mheshimiwa Spika, sasa katika mazingira haya ni kwamba biashara hii imekuwa ikifanyika. Kilichotokea ni kwamba tarehe 26 kama tulivyoeleza wanyama walitoroshwa na tunasema walitoroshwa kwa sababu document zile tatu za msingi zipo yaani kuna watu ambao wana trophy dealers license na katika kukamata walikuwa na capture permit na waliweka kwenye mazizi na kuwa na hiyo ownership certificate.

Kwa hiyo, watu wa idara ya wanyamapori baada ya kujuliwa kuwa kwamba kuna wanyama walitoka na walitoka katika mazingira yenye utata. Cha kwanza walichokifanya ni kwenda kukagua kwenye mazizi ya watu waliotajwa kwa sababu katika ku-facilitate mzigo uondoke walikuwepo watu. Kwa hiyo, walichokifanya ni kwenda kukagua kwenye mazizi ya hao watu wakawakosa wale wanyama.

Baada ya kuwakosa, ndiyo wakawaomba kwa kuangalia zile capture permit, wakawauliza una capture permit za wanyama 120 na una capture permit za ndege 16, wako wapi? Baada ya jibu kukosekana na kwa sababu alikuwepo kwenye ile process kule ikaonekana kwamba dhahiri ndiyo wale waliotoroshwa. Kwa hiyo, baada ya tukio hili kuwa reported polisi, uchunguzi huo ulikuwa ukifanyika pamoja na watu wa polisi, pamoja na watu wetu wa Idara ya Wanyamapori. Baada ya kuwa limejitokeza na wanyama wamekosekana kilichofanyika ni kuwakamata wale watu.

Kwa hiyo, wale watu sita walikamatwa wakafunguliwa kesi ya uhujumu uchumi ambao kwa namna moja au nyingine wanahusika na ule mchakato na kuna kesi ya uhujumu uchumi inaendelea Moshi. Ndiyo maana tumekuwa tukilisema suala hili kwa kigugumizi kidogo kwa sababu muda wote watu wanao-prosecute wamekuwa wakitutahadharisha sana kwamba kitu chochote ambacho mnakifanya msikiseme in public kwa sababu kwa namna moja ama nyingine mnaweza mkaathiri upelelezi.

Lakini pia kwa upande wetu tumekuwa tukifanya upelelezi na tulichokubaliana ni kwamba kila evidence tunayoipata tuwapatie watu wa DCI yaani tumpatie Mwendesha Mashitaka ili aweze kuangalia evidence ile kwa kiasi gani inaweza ikatumika kama ushahidi wa kuunganisha kwenye kesi ile.

Mheshimiwa Spika, suala hili tumekuwa tukilifanya kwa kushirikisha vyombo vyote vya ulinzi na usalama vya nchi na kabla sijafika mbali nizungumzie suala la ndege. Ile ndege iliyokuja kuchukua wanyama ni ndege iliyokuja kihalali, iliomba kibali kupitia foreign kwamba inamleta Diplomat kwenye private visit, ikapata clearance ya watu wa usalama wa anga pamoja na watu wa Jeshi la Ulinzi la Wananchi. Kwa hiyo, kufika kwake siyo kwamba rada zetu hazikuona, ziliona lakini kwa sababu watu wa Ngome na watu wa TCRA hawaji kukagua wakati inaondoka kwamba inaondoka na nini, kwa hiyo, wao kusema kweli hatuwezi kusema kwamba kuna matatizo upande huo, matatizo yapo kwenye ground handling. Kwa hiyo, ile ndege kwamba haikufika na haikuonekana kwenye vyombo vya ulinzi na usalama wa nchi, hapana, ilionekana!

Baada ya kuwa uchunguzi umefanyika na tumefika hapo, Waheshimiwa Wabunge niseme kwa dhati kabisa kwamba mimi binafsi jambo hili pamoja na kwamba limetokea siku chache sana kabla sijaapishwa, Baraza la Mawaziri lilivunjwa tarehe 5 Novemba, 2010 na nikateuliwa kuwa Waziri wa Maliasili na Utalii tarehe 24 Novemba na nikaapishwa kuwa Waziri wa Maliasili na Utalii tarehe 27 Noemba, saa nne asubuhi na wanyama waliondoka tarehe 26 Novemba usiku. Kwa hiyo, Babu John Shibuda Magalle aliyekuwa akisema kwamba kwa kiasi fulani kwa maana tu ya timing, kusema ukweli kikombe kile hakinigusi moja kwa moja. Kwa hiyo, niliona ni vizuri nilifafanue hilo hasa kwa maana ya ku-clear my personal record.

Mheshimiwa Spika, lakini mimi kama Waziri mwenye dhamana ninawajibika kufanya kila jitihada kulinda maliasili za nchi yetu na hapa ndiyo kazi yangu kubwa iliopo na ndiyo maana hatua hizi tumezichukua kuhakikisha kwamba wale watu wanachukuliwa hatua. Tumefanya uchunguzi wa ndani, tumesikiliza maoni ya Waheshimiwa Wabunge na niseme tu kwamba pamoja na uchunguzi wetu sisi ulikuwa unaendelea, pamoja na tahadhari nyingi ambazo watu wa usalama na wa upelelezi wametueleza kwamba kwa namna moja ama nyingine tuwe na tahadhari tusije tukaharibu upelelezi unaoendelea. Niseme kwamba tumekubaliana kwamba kuna mambo ambayo tunaweza tukayasema kwa sasa, moja ni kwamba kuna mazingira dhahiri ya namna moja ama nyingine watu wetu kutokufanya vizuri na niwashukuru sana Waheshimiwa Wabunge kwani tunapoongea hapa Bungeni tunaongea kwa kiapo, Mbunge hawezi kusema tu jambo kwa kuonea mtu tu.

Mheshimiwa Spika, tumekubaliana kwamba Mkurugenzi wa Wanyamapori Bwana Obed Mbangwa asimamishwe kazi kwa malipo kuanzia leo tarehe 18 Agosti, 2011 ili kupisha uchunguzi kwenye Ofisi yake. Pili, kuna watumishi wengine wawili ambao wapo chini yake kwa sababu za kiupelelezi naomba nisiwataje kwa sababu na hata humu hawakutajwa. Lakini katika kusimamishwa atasimamishwa na wenzake wawili.

Mheshimiwa Spika, na Bunge lako tukufu niwahakikishie kwamba tunaomba sana Wabunge wenzangu na Watanzania kwa mujibu wa Ibara ya 27 ya Katiba ya Nchi yetu, maliasili za nchi yetu ni zetu na tunapaswa tuzilinde kwa nguvu zote. Mimi na Ofisi yangu tutafanya kila liwezekanalo kuhakikisha wote waliohusika wanafikishwa kwenye vyombo vya Sheria.

La pili, ni kwamba jitihada za kutafuta wale wanyama zimeshaanza, niishukuru sana Kamati ya Ardhi, Maliasili na Mazingira kwa kweli wametusaidia sana. Kuna vitu vingi ambavyo mimi binafsi kwa ugeni wa hapa na pale, pamoja na Katibu Mkuu tulikuwa tunapata shida sana. Lakini niseme kwamba Kamati ya Ardhi, Maliasili na Mazingira kusema ukweli ndiyo iliyotugutua kwamba embu angalieni CITS wameshajulishwa? Tulikutana na Kamati ya Bunge mwezi Julai mwishoni, baada ya kuwa tumekutana tuka-find out tukaona hata CITS walikuwa hawajajulishwa, tukawaandikia barua CITS tarehe tarehe 2 Agosti, 2011 kuwaomba washiriki na watusaidie kwenye upelelezi na wakatujibu. Lakini hatukuwaandikia CITS peke yao tuliwaandikia pia Lusaka Agreement Task Force ambayo ni Umoja wa Ushirikiano wa Ulinzi wa Wanyamapori kwenye nchi za SADC.

Mheshimiwa Spika, vyombo hivi vinatusaidia sana wameshatujibu na tayari wameshafanya mawasiliano na watu waliopo kule kwa sababu Qatar ni mwanachama wa CITS. Kwa hiyo, upelelezi wa upande huu kujua kwamba wale wanyama wamepelekwa na final destination ni wapi na wamefikishwa kule kwa documents zipi. Hilo jambo linaendelea.

Waheshimiwa Wabunge, wapo waliozungumzia kuhusu suala la kuweka diplomatic protest au kufanya jitihada zozote zile za kidiplomasia. Washauri wa Kisheria wa suala hili wamesema ni vizuri tukajiridhisha, tusikurupuke. Ukii-attack nchi kwamba imeiba halafu ikaja ikaonyesha kwamba wale wanyama walipelekwa kwa document, tuchukulie kwamba kuna document zilizojitokeza au zilizotolewa na watu wetu somewhere, sisi tutalazimika kuomba apology kubwa sana. Kwa hiyo, ni lazima tujiridhishe kwa asilimia mia moja kwamba kweli wanyama wale wamekwenda mahali fulani na wamekwenda illegally kwa sababu eneo lingine linaloleta shida ni kwamba haiwezekani ndege ya Serikali inakuja kwa diplomatic permit ije katika mazingira ya kufanya uhalifu. Kwa hiyo, tulikuwa tumeshauriwa kwamba tukamilishe uchunguzi wa CITS pamoja
na LATF pamoja na Interpol, hivi vyombo vitatu vya ulinzi vitatusaidia kupata habari za uhakika.

Mheshimiwa Spika, habari hizi zitatusaidia ku-trace wanyama wako wapi na baada ya hapo sasa yule ambaye atakuwa na ownership nao na atakuwa na possession ndiyo atawajibika na yeye kuwa charged kwenye kesi inayoendelea lakini hatujajua ni nani hasa ambaye anao kwa sasa.

Mheshimiwa Spika, kwa hiyo, ninaomba hilo suala nilimalizie hivyo kwa kuahidi tu kwamba tutafanya kila linalowezekana na Waheshimiwa Wabunge mnapata taarifa nyingi kwani ninyi ni viongozi wa nchi, maliasili hii ni ya kwetu naomba tushirikiane kuilinda. Pale ambapo una taarifa zozote na kama humuamini mtu mwingine yeyote, naamini mimi mnaniamini, basi yeyote kati ya hawa mtupatie taarifa hiyo tutaishighulikia. Pale ambapo utakuwa umetupatia taarifa halafu ukaona kwamba tunai-handle vibaya tupo radhi utuletee hapa, uje useme tarehe 20 nilikuletea document fulani na hukuchukua hatua. Kwa sasa naomba muamini kwamba tutafanya kila linalowezekana, mimi nimekasirika kuliko muda mwingine wowote wa historia ya utumishi wangu wa umma kwa jambo hili.

Naomba nizungumzie jambo lingine ambalo limechangiwa sana na Waheshimiwa Wabunge kuhusu zoezi la ugawaji vitalu. Kwenye eneo hili kuna mambo matatu muhimu yaliyozungumzwa, la kwanza ni kuhusu utaratibu wa utangazaji, la pili ni suala la Kamati na la tatu ni suala la utaratibu wa ufunguaji wa maombi. Katika kulitazama suala hili limekuwa likiangaliwa kwa kufananisha na Sheria ya manunuzi ya umma yaani tender.

Mheshimiwa Spika, nikianza na hili la Kamati, kifungu cha 38 kinachoanzisha Kamati ya ushauri ya Waziri kinasema kwamba watakuwepo Mwenyekiti wa Kamati Block Allocation Advisory Committee to the Minister na atakuwepo Mwenyekiti ametajwa na sifa zake, eneo hilo halijazungumzwa kwamba lina matatizo.

Pili, kuna wajumbe watano ambao wametajwa kwa nyadhifa zao, ametajwa mtu wa TANAPA, Mkurugenzi wa TAWIRI, mwakilishi wa AG, Mkurugenzi wa Wanyamapori kama Katibu na ametajwa mtu mwingine mmoja sikumbuki ni nani lakini pia kuna watu watano ambao wamejatwa.

Mheshimiwa Spika, kuna watu wengine watano ambao wametajwa kwamba Waziri atateua, katika hao watu watano Sheria inasema kwamba katika kuwateua Waziri atazingatia gender, knowledge and experience in Business Administration, Conservation Matter and Economic Empowerment related matters, ukisoma kwenye Sheria inataja hayo. Wametajwa Wajumbe wawili ambao wanaonekana kwamba hawatoshi kwa kigezo hicho nilichokisema. Wajumbe hao ni Ndugu Daniel Nsanzugwanko.

Mheshimiwa Spika, Ndugu Daniel Nsanzugwanko ana MBA, ana Postgraduate Diploma in Business Administration, amekuwa Director wa Bunge Foundation, amekuwa Mkurugenzi wa Chuo cha Ushirika akifundisha mambo ya Business Management, amekuwa Mbunge, amekuwa Naibu Waziri kwa Masters in Business Administration. Knowledge inayotakiwa kwa viwango vya kawaida amezidi, kama ni siasa tuseme tunahoji ya milengo ya siasa lakini kama ni kutosha anatosha na kuzidi.

Mheshimiwa Spika, mtu mwingine amezungumziwa ni Ndugu Beno Malisa ambaye ni Graduate wa Chuo Kikuu cha Dar es Salaam mwaka 2005 akiwa na Shahada ya Sheria, Honours. Huyu sasa hivi anamalizia Postgraduate Diploma in Economic Diplomacy kutoka Centre of Foreign Relations Dar es Salaam. Lakini amefanya kazi UNICEF kwa miaka miwili kama National Facilitator wa Mradi wa Empowerment and Justice. Akitoka pale wafanye due diligence, waende kukagua mahema na magari, sidhani kama mtu mwenye degree ya Sheria atashindwa kuona hema na kusema huyu mwombaji ana hema na huyu hana. Kwa hiyo, kwa maana ya knowledge basi basic knowledge anayo na basic
experience anayo. Niseme tu kwamba kiukweli kwenye eneo hili zaidi ya kutazama kisiasa angekuwa siyo Mwenyekiti au vyovyote wa UVCCM sidhani kama ingekuwa ni issue.

Mheshimiwa Spika, sasa naomba walau kuwa-clear kwamba hawa watu na mimi mwenyewe kwamba sijawateua negligently na sehemu ya Sheria haijasema kwamba katika kuwateua watu hawa niwatangaze. The Minister na Minister ni mimi, will choose five members wenye sifa za gender balance, of course wapo wengine sijawataja kwa sababu hawajazungumziwa, sitawasema sana lakini wenye knowledge kama nilivyoeleza.

Mheshimiwa Spika, kwa hiyo, kwa upande wa Kamati kwa dhati kabisa sioni kama kuna tatizo, kama ni tatizo la upungufu wa utendaji kazi ni suala la maadili la mtu binafsi lakini siyo kwamba hana knowledge wala hana experience. Lakini kama kuna incidences za namna hiyo ni vizuri tukapeana taarifa, mimi nitachukua hatua lakini si kwa maana ya knowledge na experience, sijaona kama kuna tatizo kwenye eneo hilo.

Mheshimiwa Spika, suala la pili lililozungumziwa ni la vitalu vyenyewe kutangazwa. Mheshimiwa Spika, hatua ya tatu inayopaswa kufanyika ni kwamba waombaji wanaleta maombi Wizarani, wanalipa fees na wanapewa risiti. Baada ya hapo Kamati inafanya kazi kwa siku 60 za kuwakagua yaani kukagua mambo ya bond, kukagua kama hana bond labda ana mahema na magari kwa sababu biashara inatakiwa awe na hivyo vitu vingi ambavyo vimetajwa kwenye mwongozo. Mheshimiwa Spika, kwa hiyo, tukasema kwamba tutakuwa tunakaribisha maombi maximum ni vitalu vitano vimewekwa kwenye Sheria na katika kufanya hivyo tutahakikisha kwamba 25% ya shares za kila kampuni minimum ni Watanzania. Mheshimiwa Spika, eneo hili lina matatizo na maneno mengi, nina wasiwasi sana kwa sababu kwenye ile Kamati tuna mwakilishi wa AG, muda wote tumekuwa tukishauriana naye na hata leo nimemuuliza kwamba atuambie katika huu mchakato kwa mujibu wa Sheria kwa sababu Sheria tunayofuata ni Sheria ya Wanyamapori kifungu cha 38 na siyo Sheria ya Manunuzi ya Umma, hatununui au hatu-dispose, tunatafuta watu wa kupangisha vitalu, vitalu ni vya Serikali, tunatafuta watu wa kupangisha na utaratibu wa kuwapata umewekwa kwenye Sheria. Kwa hiyo, tumefanya consultation na Wanasheria wetu wanasema kwamba attempt yoyote kwa stage hii inaweza ikaleta matatizo kwa sababu hakuna ground yoyote ya kusema kwamba kuna kitu fulani
kimekiukwa kwa Sheria ambayo inaongoza process imefuatwa vizuri mpaka hatua hii kama kuna matatizo yanaweza yakatokea basi yatokee kuanzia sasa kwenda huko mbele.

Mheshimiwa Spika, mimi ninafikiri kwamba kwa sababu suala hili ni la kisheria na lipo kwenye Sheria ambayo Bunge hili limenitaka niisimamie ninaomba kwamba Bunge liendelee kutuamini tuukamilishe huu mchakato, pale ambapo panaonekana pana matatizo tutachukua hatua zinazostahili kwa mujibu wa Sheria kama ambavyo imeelekeza.

Mheshimiwa Spika, jambo la tatu nilizungumzie kwa kifupi sana ni suala la uchimbaji wa Urani kwenye eneo la Selous. Kwa kifupi sana tatizo lililotokea ni la consultation, inaweza ikawa ni oversight kwa upande wetu lakini inategemea jambo hilo tunalitazama vipi.

Mimi nilipoteuliwa kuwa Waziri nilipewa Katiba ya nchi, nilipofika Wizarani nikapewa Sheria, Sheria niliyopewa ni ya Wanyamapori inasema kwamba hairuhusiwi kuchimba madini kwenye hifadhi isipokuwa madini ya Urani, gesi na mafuta, hiyo ni ridhaa ya Bunge, hiyo Sheria imepitishwa na Bunge, kwa hiyo, mimi nikaona jambo hili lipo kwenye utekelezaji. Kuliambia Bunge kwamba sasa mlipitisha Sheria niruhusu kuchimba sasa wanataka kuchimba maana yake ni kwamba Sheria inasema kwamba nafasi ya Mkurugenzi ikiwa vacant sasa inahitaji kujazwa nije niliambie Bunge kwamba jamani eeh! Sasa nataka kuajiri Mkurugenzi wa Wanyamapori, is administrative. Kwa hiyo, kwa sababu lipo kwenye Sheria hivyo ndivyo tulivyolitazama.

Mheshimiwa Spika, jambo ambalo nikiri kwamba halikufanyika vizuri ni suala la ushirikishaji wa Kamati for knowledge. Hili niombe tu kwamba kwa kiasi fulani ni suala la timing, kwa sababu tulipopeleka ile taarifa yetu UNESCO tulipeleka mwezi Februari, lakini kujibiwa kwamba ajenda yenu itakuwa discussed kwa sababu unapeleka ajenda na ule ni Mkutano wa siku kumi kuanzia tarehe 19 mpaka tarehe 29. Mkishapeleka proposal zenu au taarifa zenu zinapangwa kwenye ajenda na wanawajibu kwamba proposal yenu imeingizwa kwenye ajenda na wakishawajibu ndio mnakwenda.

Kwa hiyo, sisi tulijibiwa tarehe 26 Mei, kwamba ajenda yetu itakuwa discussed na tukaambiwa inakuwa discussed kati ya tarehe 19 Juni hadi tarehe 29 Juni kipindi ambacho Bunge hili lilikuwa lipo hapa. Ndio tulikuwa tumeomba kwamba walau kwa uwakilishi twende na Mwenyekiti wa Kamati ya Nishati na Madini na Mwenyekiti wa Kamati ya Ardhi, Maliasili na Mazingira kwa niaba ya Wanakamati wote.

Mheshimiwa Spika, kwenye correspondence kati ya Wizara na Kamati huwa tunawasiliana kupitia kwa Mwenyekiti. Kwa bahati mbaya Mwenyekiti wa Kamati ya Nishati na Madini alikuwa na udhuru lakini tulikuwa na Mwenyekiti wa Kamati ya Ardhi, Maliasili na Mazingira na tulikuwa na Mbunge wa Namtumbo pamoja na timu ya wataalam ambao ni Kamati ilikuwa imeandaliwa kwa ajili ya ku-facilitate au kutetea jambo hilo.

Mheshimiwa Spika, kwa upande wetu Wizara ya Maliasili na Utalii tunachopaswa kufanya sheria yetu haitupi nafasi ya kukataa. Kama angekuja mtu kuomba anataka kuchimba rubi, Tanzanite hata kama zingekuwa za thamani gani sheria imetaja madini matatu hapo nitasimama, lakini kwa haya ambayo kwenye sheria nimeambiwa nisikatae kisheria hatuna tatizo, kwa hiyo, eneo pekee lilikuwa ni kwa sababu eneo hili lipo kwenye urithi wa dunia kwa hiyo, ikabidi tuwashirikishe UNESCO. Niombe tu kwamba kwa hatua ambazo zinafuata baada ya kuwa tumeshapeleka ombi lile na halijawa approved tumepata provisional approvement ili tufanye EIA kwa mara nyingine pamoja na wao wenyewe World Heritage Committee watume wataalam wao kwa ajili ya kuja kushirikiana na watu wa kwetu kufanya mambo ya environmental impact assessment na mkutano ujao wa 36 utakaofanyika mwezi Juni, 2012 ndio utakaosema kwamba UNESCO imeruhusu au haijaruhusu the final approval haijatoka.

Mheshimiwa Spika, nitoe tu tahadhari kwamba jambo hili kwa uchumi na kwa proposal tuliyopewa lilionekana ni la muhimu sana. Waheshimiwa Wabunge wenzangu niwaombe sana hasa wa upande wa Chama cha Mapinduzi tunazungumzia kutekeleza Ilani ya Chama cha Mapinduzi, tumeahidi mambo mengi, tumeahidi barabara za lami ukimuuliza Mheshimiwa Mwakyembe atakwambia thousands of kilometers, tumeahidi zahanati kila kijiji, tumeahidi kituo cha afya kila Kata, tumeahidi meli sehemu mbalimbali na kadhalika kama mnavyojua haya yanahitaji fedha.

Sasa hivi tuna matatizo makubwa ya umeme lakini tusipokuwa waangalifu tunaweza tukaingia kwenye mtego ambao ni kuifanya Serikali isiwe na resources huku kuchangisha au kuwashirikisha wananchi kwenye michango na kwenyewe kunafanyika kampeni wananchi wasichange, huku kutumia maliasili zetu kuchangia kwenye uchumi na kwenyewe inaonekana haiwezakani, tutashinda kutekeleza Ilani yetu. Mheshimiwa Spika, niseme tu kwamba jambo hili kwa utaratibu wa kiuchumi na nchi nyingi za Afrika na nchi zingine ambazo zinaendelea tuna changamoto kubwa sana ku-balance kati ya conservation na development. Kwa hivyo, tunahitaji ku-balance kwamba if we real need to use our resources ili watu wetu waendelee ni lazima tuangalie tunawafanyaje na tuwe na njia nzuri za kutumia rasilimali zetu na sio kuacha kabisa. Uchimbaji wa namna hii wa uranium hautafanyika Tanzania peke yake hivi tunavyozungumza Namibia wanachimba, Malawi wameanza kuchimba, Niger, Afrika ya Kusini wanachimba Uranium. Sasa hayo yanafanyika na kwingine na hata Malawi hapa wanafanya.

Mheshimiwa Spika, kwa hiyo, sisi kwa upande wetu katika Serikali tunaomba kwamba Bunge lako lione kwamba mradi huu ni wa umuhimu na tushirikiane tuzingatie sheria zilizopo, tusome Sheria ya Madini vizuri kabisa na Mheshimiwa Waziri wa Nishati na Madini nasema kwa mfano kwenye sheria ya kifungu cha 10 cha Sheria ya Madini kinasema Migodi yote itakayoanzishwa kuanzia sasa ni lazima Serikali iwe na hisa inaitwa Government Equity imetajwa au … interest kwenye migodi na mambo mengine mengi ambayo yatakuwepo kwenye migodi inayoanza. wanaonufaika ni Watanzania. Mheshimiwa Baba Mchungaji tumelifanya jambo hili kwa nia njema kabisa na wananchi wa Iringa ndio wamenufaika pia kwenye jambo hili.

Ni jambo jema na ndio maana tunaanzisha TFC au Wakala wa Misitu ili iweze kusimamia jambo hili kwa ukamilifu. Niseme wazo la kuongeza tozo hapa na pale na kuimarisha usimamizi hili tutalifanya. Kwa kiwango cha kuongeza bilioni 100 mpya inaweza isiwe rahisi kwa sababu increase yake ni zaidi ya 300 percent na tukifanya hivyo tutakuwa tumeongeza zaidi ya asilimia 270 kutoka zile 30 tulizoshusha hapa hapatatosha Bunge lijalo, kwa hiyo, tutaangalia kuongeza lakini kuongeza very cautiously.

Mheshimiwa Spika, eneo lingine lililozungumzwa kwa kirefu sana ni suala la concession fees, niwashukuru sana Waheshimiwa Wabunge, sana tu. Mimi kama ambavyo wote mmenisisitiza nitasimama imara na tumekwishaanza kutafuta mbinu zingine za kukabiliana na tatizo hili.

La kwanza ambalo tumewaambia TANAPA wafanye ni kwamba kwenye maeneo yote ambayo watakuwa wameyatangaza kwa ajili ya uwekezaji ikiwezekana na wenyewe wahakikishe wanakuwa na free carriage interests kwenye maeneo yale, yaani mtu akija kuwekeza pale TANAPA awe na asilimia 30. Wakati wakifanya hivyo maana yake watakuwa na shares kwenye hoteli zote zitakazojengwa kwenye hifadhi au lodges. Lakini jambo lingine ni kwamba kwa sababu sekta binafsi tumeona wakati mwingine inakuwa haina huruma tumetoka kukabiliana nao juzi kwenye mambo ya mafuta, sasa hivi tena the same group tunakabiliana nao kwenye mambo ya hoteli. Katika mazingira haya ni muhimu vyombo vyetu vya Serikali viweze kushiriki.

Kwa hiyo, tumewaambia TANAPA maeneo wanapoyatangaza waangalie vyombo vya Serikali vyenye uwezo wa kifedha National Housing, NSSF, TANAPA, wenyewe Ngorongoro wajenge hoteli, wawakaribishe wenye utaalam wa kuziendesha waziendeshe kama waendeshaji tu. Lakini wakati tunafanya jambo hilo suala la concession fees na yote tuliyokubaliana tutayasimamia.

Mheshimiwa Spika, Baba Mchungaji amezungumzia suala la barua niliyoandika, ni kweli niliandika barua, baada ya jambo hili kutangazwa wale jamaa walifanya mgomo, walifanya strike hawa jamaa na waka-strike na hawa tour operators kina Mheshimiwa Akunaay wakapeleka magari mengi zaidi ya 200 pale navigate yamejaa magari pale Tarangile, watalii wanasumbuliwa na kila siku tunahitaji kuwabembeleza. Nimepigiwa simu na Mabalozi kwamba watu wako getini toka saa 4.00 asubuhi wamezuiwa kuingia hifadhini wanalazimishwa walipe na hawa akina Mzee Akunaay.

Mzee Akunaay ni mdau mkubwa sana wa tour operators namtaja kwa heshima na sio kwa ubaya. Wakawa wamesema kwamba hawa hawakutaarifiwa kwamba watakuwa Mawakala wetu wa kuwa wanakusanya. Ni kweli waliandikiwa barua, lakini hawakuwa engaged kwenye majadiliano. Wageni wapo getini imefika saa 10 hawana pa kulala ndio nikawaambia waruhusuni wageni, msiwaingize kwenye mtego hawa tour operators akina Mheshimiwa Akunaay na wageni. Tatizo lenu ni ninyi na hoteli. Waruhusuni wageni waende hotelini wapate mahali pa kulala halafu muwadai wale watu kwa sababu mnajua mhesabu wageni wangapi wamepita hapa getini.

Kwa hiyo, pale getini mfanye kazi ya kuwahesabu wageni halafu kule mkusanye atakayekataa tutashughulika naye ili tuondoe usumbufu kwa wageni. Kilichofanyika pale ilikuwa ni kuokoa sekta. Tulikuwa tunapata embarassment kubwa sana ya nchi, wageni wamehangaika pale na wamekwenda na message mbaya sana, nimeandika barua ya kuomba radhi kwenye Balozi za nchi za Ulaya na Marekani kwa sababu tumefanya kitu ambacho si kizuri kwa wageni ambao wala hawahusiki na mzozo ule.

Mheshimiwa Spika, suala lingine lililozungumziwa ni suala la kifuta jasho na kifuta machozi kwamba ni kidogo na kinachelewa. Niseme tu haraka haraka hizi kanuni tumezianza kuzitumia kwa mara ya kwanza tarehe 24 Aprili ndio tumezisaini. Kweli sehemu nyingi tumezungumza na wananchi, juzi tulikuwa kwa rafiki yangu Mheshimiwa Jerome Bwanausi kule Masasi, wananchi wanalalamika kuwa hazitoshi.

Niseme Waheshimiwa Wabunge wenzangu kwa sababu ndio tunaanza kuzitumia na tumeona reaction ya public tutachukua maoni yenu tutaangalia namna ya kuboresha. Suala la kuwaisha kulipa ni suala la utendaji na kwenye suala hili nimemwambia Mkurugenzi na wananchi nimewaomba sana na niwaombe kupitia Bunge lako Tukufu kwamba pale panapotokea matatizo haya taarifa zifikishwe Wizarani, wakatufikishia Wizarani na taarifa zikiwa zimekamilika ndani ya mwezi mmoja yaani siku 30 madai yale yawe yamelipwa. Nimemwomba Naibu Katibu Mkuu alisimamie suala hili kwa ukamilifu na pale ambapo watu watakuwa wanachelewa kulipwa bila sababu za msingi tuweze kuchukua hatua. Kwa hiyo, suala la ucheleweshaji tunalisimamia vizuri na suala la kuboresha rate tutaliangalia.

Mheshimiwa Spika, kuna suala lingine limezungumzwa kwa kirefu sana, suala la Ngorongoro. Suala la Ngorongoro lina mambo mengi, mimi nilikwenda kule baada ya kuwa nimesikia kwenye vyombo vya habari kwamba kuna tatizo kubwa sana la njaa. Nimezungumza na wale wananchi, kikubwa ambacho nakiona pale kwa kweli wale wananchi dhahiri wanaonekana kabisa kwamba hawaridhiki na mchango ambao Ngorongoro inafanya, Ngorongoro imeelekeza kisheria kwamba iwaendeleze wale watu, wala sio iwape kipaumbele iwaendeleze. Kama inavyohangaika kuendeleza utalii, kama inavyohangaika kumlinda faru inahangaika na maendeleo ya hawa watu. Haiwezekani hawa watu ambao umeagiza kisheria uwaendeleze, wanakaa na njaa karibu wiki mbili, mahindi yako kwenye ma-godown tumekwenda, tumekuta mahindi yapo kwenye ma-godown watu wana njaa karibu ya kufa, nikasema hamuwezi mkafanya hivyo milioni 48 za kusambaza mahindi mmekosa.

Kwa hiyo, vitu vya namna hiyo nimewaambia kwamba ni lazima warudi kwenye sheria, walisimamie jambo hilo, ili waweze kulifanya jambo hilo kwa ukamilifu wawe karibu na wananchi. Nikasema safari za nje zifanyike pale ambapo ni watendaji wanakwenda kufanya kazi husika, haiwezekani kuna wakati nilikwenda kwenye maonyesho Madrid, tumekwenda na watu kule lugha zinazozungumzwa lugha ya Kifaransa na Kiespaniora, tumekwenda na watu wanazungumza Kiswahili na Kiingereza na ni msafara wa watu watano kwa sababu tu amefikiwa zamu ya kwenda kwa sababu safari imekuwa ni ulaji, mimi nikasema hapana, ni lazima tupeleke watu wanaokwenda kufanya kazi. Pale ambapo hakuna sababu za kufanya hivyo tusifanye na ndio nilichokifanya Ngorongoro. Najua wananuna lakini naomba sana tunafanya hayo kwa nia njema sana ili wale watu ambao kweli tunawafanyia kazi waone kwamba tunafanya kazi zinazopaswa kufanywa.

Mheshimiwa Spika, kuna suala la usimamizi kwa maana ya Bodi, serious allegations zimekuwa raised. Mimi nimekuwa ninaomba kwanza kwa sababu tuliyemzungumzia ni mtu ambaye kwa kweli hana nafasi ya kufika hapa na kujitetea au kueleza. Sisi ambacho tumekiona kwenye Serikali na tumezungumza na Mkuu wangu Mheshimiwa Waziri Mkuu hapa kwamba tuunde Tume ya Msingi ya kwenda kuchunguza ni matendo gani ambayo yanafanyika kwenye eneo hilo, baada ya kazi hiyo kukamilika tutachukua hatua. Niwahakikishie tu na waandishi wa habari nilipoteuliwa kuwa Waziri waliniuliza Maige tunakuona mdogo, unachekacheka nikawaambia subirini miaka miwili unless pasiwepo sheria, tukigundua kwamba kuna matatizo tutachukua hatua. Kwa hiyo, hilo nawaomba msiwe na wasiwasi.

Suala la kujenga hoteli kwenye mapito ya faru tulipata taarifa hizo na niwaambie tu kwa kifupi kwamba jambo hilo tulishalizuia na nilishapata barua ya Mhifadhi (Conservator) akiwaandikia wale waliokuwa wamepangiwa kujengewa hoteli kwenye eneo lile au amekuwa allocated hilo eneo kwamba wanajengewa watatafutiwa maeneo mengine. Kwa hiyo, kama ambavyo Mheshimiwa Kaika Telele mngekuwa hamuibi ng’ombe Shinyanga ingekuwa vizuri zaidi. Kama ambavyo amesema mtani wangu Telele kwamba hoteli haitajengwa kwenye mapito ya faru na mimi nalihakikishie Bunge hili kwamba hoteli hii haitajengwa.

Mheshimiwa Spika, suala la utangazaji wa utalii yameelezwa mengi, lakini niseme tu kwamba moja ya changamoto kubwa tuliyonayo ni fedha. TTB ambacho ni chombo cha kutangaza utalii kinapata fedha kutoka Hazina na kinapata shilingi bilioni nne kwa mwaka tena ndio kiwango cha juu ambacho kinajumlisha mambo ya mishahara na kila kitu. Fedha zinazotumika kwa ajili ya utangazaji wa utalii kuweka matangazo sijui kwenye mpira wa Premium League na nini ni chini ya asilimia 35 ya fedha zote ambazo zinakuwa wamepangia, I mean chini ya asilimia 35 ya fedha zote walizokuwa wamepangiwa.

Mheshimiwa Spika, fedha hizi by far ndogo huwezi ukalinganisha na wenzetu Kenya, wenzetu Kenya wanazungumzia sisi tuna about 4 billion shllings wao wana about 16 billion dollars. Afrika ya Kusini wana about 70 millions dollars kwa mwaka kwa ajili ya kutangaza utalii ambao kwenye ukanda wetu wao tuna mazingira ya kufafanana.

Kwa hiyo, katika mazingira hayo nikasema ni vizuri tutafute mbinu za kuhakikisha kwamba tunatangaza effectively ndio tukasema kwamba haiwezekani kwamba eti hawa jamaa kwa sababu wana Bajeti kubwa na wana uwezo wa kukusanya sasa wawe wanaenda kwa zamu hata mlinzi aende kutangaza utalii kwa sababu amefikia zamu na kwa sababu safari ndio mtaji wa kupata fedha, tutafute namna ya kutumia fedha hizi vizuri. Ngorongoro waende, lakini waende wataalam na wanaopaswa kufanya kazi hiyo na washiriki kwenye maonesho mengi zaidi iwezekanavyo waende watu wa TTB, ndiyo hoja aliyoisema kaka yangu Chifu Lembeli pale.

Mheshimiwa Spika, kulikuwa na hofu tumezungumzia kwamba TANAPA watawanyang’anya fedha wasiende kutangaza utalii, hapana. Tumesema kwamba tuwe na Joint Tourism Promotion Plan ambayo itawahusisha TANAPA, Ngorongoro lakini atakayekuwa anaongoza kufanya kazi hiyo ni mtu wa TTB. Kwa hiyo, pamoja na kuomba fedha lakini nilihakikishie Bunge lako Tukufu kwamba tutajitahidi kuwa effective na kutumia rasilimali tunazozipata vizuri.

Mheshimiwa Spika, jambo lingine ambalo limezungumzwa na Wabunge wengi sana ni suala la migogoro ya mipaka. Watu wameongezeka, hifadhi zipo, mipaka haiko wazi, tuna migogoro mingi kwenye maeneo mengi. Kwa kifupi sana niseme ifuatavyo; la kwanza niwape pole sana wananchi wa Urambo, nimemsikiliza sana Dada yangu Mheshimiwa Sakaya.

Mheshimiwa Spika, kwa kiasi kikubwa sana nimesikitika mno. Tumeongea na Mheshimiwa Waziri Mkuu kwamba jambo hili nalo kama lilivyo la Ngorongoro kama ulivyoomba Dada Sakaya chini ya maelekezo ya Mheshimiwa Waziri Mkuu tutaunda timu ya watu kwenda kuangalia independently na kwa sababu suala hilo linahusu Wilaya nzima maana yake tunahitaji kuchukua watu nje ya Maliasili na nje ya TAMISEMI kwa maana ya uongozi wa Wilaya pale ili tuweze kwenda kuangalia ni kwa kiasi gani jambo hili limefanyika. Kwa sababu kuwatoa watu kwenye hifadhi ni jambo la kawaida kiutaratibu na sehemu zingine operesheni zilifanyika, lakini si kiwango cha Urambo ambacho tumeelezwa leo hii.

Mheshimiwa Spika, niseme tu Tume ile itakapomaliza kazi yake itatusaidia kuweza kufanya maamuzi na moja ya maamuzi ya msingi kuhusu namna ya kutumia ile ardhi kwa pamoja, lakini la pili kuhusu hatua stahiki za kinidhamu ambazo zitaweza kuchukuliwa kwa watu ambao wamefanya mambo hayo ambayo kwenye Sheria yoyote, Sheria ya Maliasili, Sheria yoyote ile inayosema kwamba uchome nyumba na mahindi na mazao mengine ya Mtanzania.

Kwa hiyo, jambo hilo hatutaliruhusu, tutachukua hatua na tutakufahamisha jinsi hatua zinavyokwenda. Kwa maeneo mengine, niseme tu kwamba tulishaanza kufanya ukaguzi kwa maana tulishaanza kuangalia mazingira ya mipaka nchi nzima. Tabora tulishapata taarifa yake, niombe tu kwamba kwa mwaka huu wa fedha tulioanza na ambao ndiyo naombea fedha leo, suala hili tutalifanya kwa nchi nzima kwa kushirikiana na wenzetu wa Wizara ya Ardhi ili tuangalie na kwenye maeneo yaliyo mengi tumekubaliana kuangalia yale maeneo ambayo seriously yanahitajika kiuhifadhi, tutazungumza na wananchi tuwaeleze ni kwa kiasi gani ni ya muhimu. Kwa maeneo mengine ambayo kwa namna moja au nyingine yanayoweza yakaonekana kwamba si ya lazima kiasi hicho kwa uhifadhi, tutazungumza nao, tutafanya utaratibu wa kurekebisha mipaka
ili kuondoa migogoro hii once and for all. Kwa hiyo, naomba niliahidi Bunge lako Tukufu kwamba katika kipindi hiki ambacho kinaanza baada ya bajeti hii kupitishwa tutaweza kuyarekebisha hayo.

Mheshimiwa Spika, nimalizie suala moja ya Mufindi kabla sijaanza yale mengine ambayo ni specific areas. Suala la Mufindi na malighafi, ni kweli kwamba kuna matatizo ya namna malighafi hii inavyogawanywa. Ni kweli kwenye mwongozo tumesema kwamba wananchi wanaoishi vijiji jirani na eneo waweze kupata namna fulani ya kunufaika. Hatujawa very clear kama tutoe fedha za kuwachangia kwenye miradi yao ya maendeleo au tuwachingie mbao au namna gani lakini kwa kiasi kikubwa tumekuwa tukitoa vibali vya kuvuna. Kosa ambalo tumekuwa tukilifanya ni kwamba tumekuwa tukitoa vibali kwa maombi yanayoandikwa na mtu. Kwa hiyo, mtu yupo Tabora lakini anaandika Francis Mayala, S.L.P. 14 Njombe, S.L.P. 276 Iringa, ili aonekane ni wa eneo jirani kwa sababu jambo hili kwamba wananchi wa jirani wana nafasi zaidi linajulikana. Kwa hiyo, inawezekana wapo watu ambao hawaishi kwenye maeneo yale wanatumia majina na anuani za maeneo yale, tutaimarisha eneo hilo ili kuhakikisha kweli tunaowalenga kuwanufaisha au kuwapa kupaumbele, kipaumbele hicho wanakipata.

Mheshimiwa Spika, niombe ushauri wa Bunge lako Tukufu, Waheshimiwa Wabunge wameomba wawe wajumbe wa Kamati hizi za uvunaji, lakini nina tatizo kubwa moja kwamba Wabunge walio wengi na wenyewe wanaomba kuvuna, sasa tukiwaweka kwenye Kamati sijui itakuwaje. Kwa hiyo, nataka hili jambo tuliache kwa ajili ya mjadala lakini sisi tumekuwa tukiona ni haki yake Mbunge kwa niaba ya wananchi wake, anataka labda asaidie madawati, amepewa CDCF na kuna Wabunge wenzangu wengi tu hapa wameongea na Magereza kwamba watawasaidia ku-process zile mbao na kutengeneza madawati, anaomba kuvuna na anaruhusiwa kama Mtanzania na kama kiongozi tena anapewa heshima zaidi. Ama tusiwape Wabunge wa jirani pale kama anataka kuchangia kwenye madawati ili wawe wajumbe wa Kamati au wasiwe wajumbe wa Kamati ili pale wanapohitaji na wenyewe kuchangia mbao iweze kuwezekana. Ni suala la conflict of interest. Kwa hiyo, hili suala sisi hatuna tatizo tutaangalia namna ya kufanya na kweli tumesema kwenye mwaka huu wa fedha tutaliangalia eneo hili. Kwa kifupi hili eneo kwa sababu linahitaji mjadala tutakaa na Waheshimiwa Wabunge na viongozi wengine wa maeneo haya tuweze kushauriana njia nzuri zaidi ya kulifanya jambo hili.
Mheshimiwa Spika, kwa maslahi ya muda, nizungumzie kwa harakaharaka mambo yafuatayo:-

Moja, kuna suala la mgogoro wa MPM kutoza kiasi kidogo. Tatizo lililokuwepo ni kwamba kiwanda hiki kilikuwa ni cha Serikali kikabinafsishwa, wakaingia mkataba kwamba watakuwa wananunua si mbao hasa, sanasana ni yale maotea ambayo watakuwa wana-prune. Nimeambiwa kwamba wametoka kwenye kukata maotea sasa wanakata kabisa magogo na ndiyo maana bei yao imekuwa iko chini na jambo hili wala haliko hapa lipo hata sehemu zingine. Kwa hiyo, tumeshakubaliana kwenye mwaka huu wa fedha kwamba malighafi ambayo itakuwa inatolewa kwenye maeneo yote itakuwa na bei moja. Kwa hiyo, suala hili tutalirekebisha lakini dhana iliyokuwepo ilikuwa ni ya kuangalia kwamba wao wanahitaji material kwa ajili ya kutengeneza vitu vingine ambavyo vinahitaji vimiti vidogovidogo.

Mheshimiwa Spika, limezungumziwa suala la TFS kwamba kuanzisha Wakala wa Misitu unaweza ukaathiri misitu. Jambo hili lilikuwa ni miongoni mwa sababu zilizotuchelewesha kuanzisha TFS lakini sababu ya msingi ya kuanzisha Wakala wa Misitu (TFS) ni suala la kuhakikisha kwamba kadri itakavyowezakana fedha zinazokusanywa kwenye sekta hii zinatumika kuendeleza sekta hii. Sekta ya misitu inakusanya shilingi bilioni 38, mkipeleka Hazina zinarudishwa shilingi bilioni nane au tisa. Hamwezi kuendeleza yale mashamba ndiyo maana tukaanzisha LMDA ambayo ndiyo imesaidia kupanda miti. Ukiangalia mashamba mengi miti iliyopo ni michanga imepandwa katika miaka miwili au mitatu iliyopita kwa sababu vipaumbele vya Serikali ni kwamba fedha zikishakusanywa zinaingia kwenye Mfuko Mkuu wa Hazina, inakuwa si rahisi kurudi kwenye eneo ambalo imetoka.
Mheshimiwa Spika, kwa hiyo tukaona kwamba ni vizuri tuanzishe wakala ambao utakuwa unakusanya kama wanavyofanya TANAPA, kama wanavyofanya Ngorongoro, Ngorongoro

hawajamaliza wanyama, TANAPA hawajamaliza wanyama na TFS hawatamaliza misitu. Watavuna kwenye mashamba, watakuwa kwenye harvest plans na kuangalia miti itakavyokuwa inakuwa na watakuwa wanasimamia hivyo. Kuna uzoefu nchi nyingi zimeanzisha Wakala wa Misitu na zimefanya vizuri sana, baada ya miaka mitatu, minne nakuhakikishia hatutakuwa na uharibifu wa misitu kiasi hiki. Unasikia kabisa kwamba kuna maeneo kama Kilindi watu wanafyeka misitu left and right, Askari au Idara ya Misitu hakuna chochote wanachoweza kufanya. Mna-District Forest mmoja ambaye kazi yake ni kugawa vibali basi lakini hana uwezo wa kufanya patrol kwenye maeneo yote. Kwa hiyo, tumesema kupitia TFS tutaajiri Forest Rangers, tutawanunulia pikipiki, watakuwa wanafanya doria katika misitu na watakuwa wanapanda miti, sekta itaimarika na changamoto tulizonazo zitaweza kupungua.
Mheshimiwa Spika, haya ambayo sitayatolea ufafanuzi, yasije yakanibana kwenye vifungu, nitawapatia kwa maandishi.

Mheshimiwa Spika, jambo lingine lililozungumzwa ni uboreshaji wa huduma kwenye sekta ya utalii kwamba huduma kwenye sekta ya utalii sio bora lakini pia hata utalii wa Mlima Kilimanjaro kuna matatizo, ameeleza sana Mheshimiwa Kiongozi wa Upinzani Bungeni. Tulichokubaliana ni kwamba tuna Sheria mpya ya Utalii ya mwaka 2008. Sheria hii inaelekeza nini kifanyike. Moja, inasema hotel ziwekwe kwenye madaraja, wataalam au watumishi wanaofanya kazi kwenye sekta hii wafundishwe na ndiyo maana tuna Chuo cha Utalii na tuna campus mpya ya Dar es Salaam ambayo itaongeza udahili wa wakufunzi kwenye eneo hilo ili waweze kutoa elimu zilizo bora. Pia kwa Sheria, hotel tutaziweka kwenye grades na tutasimamia ubora wake.

Mheshimiwa Spika, kwa hotel ama huduma zinazotolewa kwa watalii hasa kwa upande wa mlima, tumezungumza na KINAPA, kwa kifupi sana kwa sababu ya muda na wamesema kulikuwa na suala la kuwa wanaruhusu camping kule kwenye crater. Niliongea na Mheshimiwa Owenya, tumesema jambo hilo tutaliangalia. Kuna sababu za msingi za kusimamisha. Faida ya fedha tunayoipata ni kidogo kuliko hasara ambayo tunaipata. Kwa hiyo, kwa kutumia KINAPA, tutaimarisha huduma kwa ujumla kwenye eneo hilo.

Mheshimiwa Spika, kwa kumalizia, nimalizie kwa kifupi sana suala la WMA ya Ipole lililotolewa na kaka yangu Mheshimiwa Said Mkumba. Tumekubaliana na nimeshatoa maelekezo kwa wenzangu kwamba utengenezwe Mkataba wa Makubaliano (MoU) kati ya WMA na watu wa misitu ili WMA iwepo, isipokuwa utumiaji wa mazao ya misitu yaliyoko kwenye hiyo WMA usimamiwe na Idara ya Misitu.

Mheshimiwa Spika, kwa kuzingatia kwamba muda kwa kweli haupo kabisa upande wangu, naomba hoja zote ambazo sijakamilisha kuzijibu, niwaahidi Waheshimiwa Wabunge kwamba tutazijibu kwa maandishi na wote tutawapatia na kwenye vifungu pale ambapo mnaona kabisa kwamba huyu bwana anaweza akawa hana jibu mkononi basi mlione hilo kwamba ni vizuri mkasubiri lile jibu la maandishi ambalo tutakuwa tumeji-commit zaidi pamoja na kwamba kwenye vifungu tutaji-commit.

Mheshimiwa Spika, kwa kifupi na kama nilivyowasilisha hoja jana asubuhi ya kuomba fedha kwa ajili ya utekelezaji wa mambo ambayo tumeyaombea fedha hapa au tumeyakusudia basi niombe Bunge lako Tukufu liweze kuidhinisha bajeti ya Wizara ya Maliasili na Utalii.
Mheshimiwa Spika, naomba kutoa hoja.
Mheshimiwa Spika, naafiki.

Waheshimiwa Wabunge, hoja hii imeungwa mkono. Kuna addendum iligawiwa kipindi kama cha wiki mbili zilizopita kwa sababu mkiangalia Development Budget ya Wizara hii, katika Kitabu cha Nne, kuna zero allocation. Sasa addendum iliyogawiwa, inaonyesha kwamba hawa wamekuwa allocated shilingi milioni 107,620,000/-. Sasa kama mngekuwa nayo mngeona maeneo gani yamekuwa allocated. Kwa hiyo, kuna hiyo addendum. Katibu!
